scope: Proposition 8.5 (Transport of the visible coefficients) of the manuscript “Cutoff throughout the high-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick phase” (preprints/Cutoff-throughout-the-high-temperature-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-phase-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 227 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d99d391c8c3ed79f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 86. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For prescribed comparison times a ≤ s < t ≤ b retained in the preceding construction, qs = (Kt−s ˆ︁ ⊗ Cs,t)qt. (8.11) The identity also holds for the retained selected-time sequences with positive limiting separation: Kt−s uses that limiting separation, while Cs,t is induced by their actual conditional expectations. For an interior time s with a fixed positive amount of future evolution, qs belongs to the graph domain of componentwise L in the vector factor, with graph norm bounded by Ct−s ∥qt∥. No derivative is taken on the scalar factor.
